---
title: Antiguitat de l’edificació i veïnatge
lang: ca
ref: figura-autocorrelacio-edat
format: gfm
execute-dir: project
execute: {echo: false, warning: false}
unaltraweb_compute:
  engine: python
  mode: figure
  inputs: [context/inputs/autocorrelacio-exemples.json, context/inputs/seccions-tarragones.geojson]
  outputs: [assets/img/generated/autocorrelacio-edat.svg]
---

```{python}
from pathlib import Path
import json
import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from matplotlib.path import Path as MPath
from matplotlib.patches import PathPatch,Patch
from matplotlib.colors import BoundaryNorm,ListedColormap
from matplotlib.cm import ScalarMappable
root=Path.cwd()
while not (root/'.unaltraweb/computations.yml').exists():
    if root==root.parent:raise RuntimeError('Projecte absent')
    root=root.parent
d=json.loads((root/'context/inputs/autocorrelacio-exemples.json').read_text())
features=json.loads((root/'context/inputs/seccions-tarragones.geojson').read_text())['features']
rows=d['local']['age-queen'];bycode={r['key']:r for r in rows}
result=next(r for r in d['trials'] if r['id']=='age-queen')
plt.rcParams.update({'font.family':'DejaVu Sans','font.size':18,'svg.fonttype':'none','svg.hashsalt':'autocorrelacio-edat'})
fig,axes=plt.subplots(1,2,figsize=(11.5,5.8),layout='constrained')
cmap=ListedColormap(['#f6edcc','#c8d7ad','#84b4a1','#428990','#275775']);norm=BoundaryNorm([0,30,45,60,90,180],5)
for f in features:
    key=f['properties']['cusec'];g=f['geometry'];parts=g['coordinates'] if g['type']=='MultiPolygon' else [g['coordinates']]
    for part in parts:
        vertices=[];codes=[]
        for ring in part:
            vertices.extend(np.asarray(ring)/1000);codes.extend([MPath.MOVETO]+[MPath.LINETO]*(len(ring)-2)+[MPath.CLOSEPOLY])
        axes[0].add_patch(PathPatch(MPath(vertices,codes),facecolor=cmap(norm(bycode[key]['value'])) if key in bycode else '#dddddd',
                                   edgecolor='white',lw=.45))
axes[0].autoscale_view();axes[0].set(aspect='equal',xticks=[],yticks=[],title='Mediana d’edat dels edificis')
for spine in axes[0].spines.values():spine.set_visible(False)
axes[0].plot([362,367],[4548,4548],color='#223644',lw=3);axes[0].text(364.5,4547.5,'5 km',ha='center',va='top',fontsize=16)
bar=fig.colorbar(ScalarMappable(norm=norm,cmap=cmap),ax=axes[0],orientation='horizontal',fraction=.065,pad=.035,ticks=[0,30,60,90,180])
bar.set_label('Anys d’antiguitat respecte de 2026',fontsize=17)
ax=axes[1];z=np.array([r['z'] for r in rows]);lag=np.array([r['lag_z'] for r in rows])
ax.scatter(z,lag,color='#3c8695',s=30,alpha=.8);xs=np.array([z.min()-.2,z.max()+.3]);ax.plot(xs,result['I']*xs,color='#b52e45',lw=2)
ax.axhline(0,color='#89949a',lw=.8);ax.axvline(0,color='#89949a',lw=.8)
ax.set(title='150 seccions · I = 0,355',xlabel='Edat de la secció\n(estandarditzada)',ylabel='Mitjana de les veïnes\n(estandarditzada)')
fig.legend(handles=[Patch(facecolor='#dddddd',label='Una secció amb menys de 10 edificis datats: exclosa')],
           loc='outside lower center',frameon=False,fontsize=16)
fig.savefig(root/'assets/img/generated/autocorrelacio-edat.svg',facecolor='white',metadata={'Date':None});plt.close(fig)
```
